entries.purpose: Check logic, risk and approval before risky actions.
Track provider quota, cooldown and live/stale status.
Choose providers by task, quota, cost, privacy and capability.
Separate update cloud, central brain, user brain and archives.
Group same-purpose modules into core families.
Protect private user and owner data.
Hydrate new AI/provider sessions from canonical Project State, Checkpoints and Handoff Packets.
Detect exact/near duplicate work, knowledge and modules before creating new records; escalate only ambiguous cases.
Store entities, relations, provenance and revisioned facts with referential-integrity validation.
Create deterministic fingerprints for idempotency and duplicate prevention across tasks/projects.
Suggest reuse/merge/link decisions to the Brain while keeping final semantic decisions in INVENTHOR.
Read-only audit of per-project module capability completeness, missing evidence, stale observations and ambiguous ownership; host must independently verify.
Plan owner-selected custom modules and extension of existing modules without vendor, provider or product category whitelist; Main host verifies owner and performs authorized installation.
Owner-adjustable free-first finite Main work progression: verified dependency receipts, quota/file limits, duplicate fingerprint prevention, one host-lease candidate only.
Project-scoped learning from Codex and other agents' failures and independently verified repairs; create bounded reuse advisories, never auto-apply unknown patches.
Deterministically identify missing module capability and match stable fingerprint against existing Main Work Items before proposing a new intake; never silently create a task.
